definitions.explanation: An establishment where meals are prepared and served to customers. Often implies a sit-down restaurant with prepared cuisine, as opposed to a fast-food outlet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{料理店|りょうりてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new restaurant opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{料理店|りょうりてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。

⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イタリア→イタリア：19423_itaria⟧{料理店|りょうりてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}して→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}った→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。
examples.english: I reserved a well-regarded local Italian restaurant to celebrate a family birthday.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cooking, cuisine) and ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop, establishment). A relatively formal way to say "restaurant" that appears often in written Japanese and official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本料理店|にほんりょうりてん}: Japanese restaurant
- {中華料理店|ちゅうかりょうりてん}: Chinese restaurant
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{料理店|りょうりてん}: high-end restaurant
- {料理店|りょうりてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to run a restaurant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧: restaurant (loanword) — the most common casual term, often implies Western-style dining
- ⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧: food and drink establishment — a broader legal/administrative term covering restaurants, bars, and cafes
- ⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧: dining hall, eatery — implies a more casual, everyday eating place
- ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧: traditional Japanese restaurant — high-end, with private rooms and elaborate multi-course meals
